title: Resource Pack Command
description: A command To Push/Pop resource packs
body:
Adds a command called /rp, it allows you to push/pop resource packs, thats literally it, its syntax is fairly simple and goes as follows:
/rp push [targets] <name> <url>
/rp pop [targets] <name>

name can be anything you want but sometimes url will need to be in quotes
an example of the syntax is:

/rp push AlessioDC09 bareToTheBones 'https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/rox3U8B6/versions/jQBWn2Q3/Bare%20Bones%201.21.11.zip'

and to get rid of it:

/rp pop AlessioDC09 bareToTheBones

This Mod was created for making adventure maps 
and if you want to make them too then this mod is GREAT for things like invisible maze mini-games, or a sort of parkour where there are mutiple surfaces and you have to remember the colors atrribute modifiers, the possibilties are endless!

**PLEASE DON'T USE IT TO LAG PEOPLE OUT**
